primary.title: ITR filing 2026: When you'll receive Form 16 and who will issue it if you switched jobs last year
primary.summary: As the ITR filing season for FY 2025-26 begins, salaried taxpayers await Form 16, essential for accurate income tax filing. Employers must issue it by June 15, 2026, with employees needing it to verify earnings and tax deductions before the July 31 filing deadline.
